items.title: Trump Says Top Tech Firms Have Signed Accord to ‘Self-Police’ AI Development
items.description: The accord opened the door to future regulation but focused on four voluntary steps for the companies to take. The post Trump Says Top Tech Firms Have Signed Accord to ‘Self-Police’ AI Development appeared first on SecurityWeek.

items.title: Apple Zero-Day Vulnerability Weaponized in Targeted Attacks
items.description: Attackers are exploiting CVE-2026-86950, an out-of-bounds write flaw, in an extremely sophisticated fashion, according to Apple.

items.title: Signal adds encypted local backup support to iOS, desktop apps
items.description: Signal, the secure messaging app, released version 8.30, completing the rollout of its secure backups feature across all supported operating systems (Android, iOS, Linux, macOS, and Windows). [...]

items.title: Unsloth Studio Flaw Turns Routine Model Inspection Into Code Execution
items.description: A patched Unsloth Studio vulnerability allows malicious AI models to execute arbitrary Python code during inspection, via the trust_remote_code setting.
